recognize_zh: 周邊血液可見中型淋巴球，核圓至卵圓、染色質略塊狀、核仁不明顯，細胞質豐富、淡灰藍色，周緣有細毛狀突起；骨髓切片細胞間距寬、呈「荷包蛋（fried-egg）」樣，CD20 強陽性、Annexin A1 陽性，流式 CD103、CD25、CD200 陽性且 lambda 單株性，符合毛狀細胞白血病（HCL）。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei and low-moderate N:C ratio
Moderately condensed ('spongy') chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections
BM aspirate: sheets of monotonous cells with oval to slightly indented nuclei and ragged pale cytoplasm
BM biopsy: diffuse infiltrate of widely spaced nuclei separated by clear cytoplasm (fried-egg pattern) with red cell extravasation
IHC: CD20 strongly positive, Annexin A1 positive, cyclin D1 weak nuclear; flow CD103+, CD25+, CD200+, CD123 largely negative, lambda-restricted
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fine circumferential hair-like projections, admixed with a small mature lymphocyte. The bone marrow aspirate contains sheets of morphologically similar cells. The core biopsy shows a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous cells with evenly spaced round to oval nuclei surrounded by clear cytoplasm, imparting a fried-egg appearance, with areas of red cell extravasation. Immunohistochemistry shows strong CD20, cytoplasmic Annexin A1 and weak nuclear cyclin D1 (BCL1) expression, and flow cytometry identifies a lambda-restricted B-cell population (97.6% of B cells) expressing bright CD20, CD103, CD25 and CD200 with little or no CD123. Findings are consistent with hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: HCL-v cells have a prominent nucleolus, lack CD25 and Annexin A1 and are BRAF V600E negative, whereas these cells have inconspicuous nucleoli and express CD25 and Annexin A1.

SMZL villous lymphocytes have polar (bipolar) short projections and are typically CD103-, CD25-/weak, Annexin A1-negative with a nodular/intrasinusoidal marrow pattern rather than diffuse fried-egg infiltration.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL shows broad-based villous cytoplasm, intrasinusoidal marrow involvement and is Annexin A1-negative and usually CD25-negative, unlike this Annexin A1+/CD25+ infiltrate.
MCL is cyclin D1 strongly positive but CD5+, CD103-, CD25- and Annexin A1-negative with scant cytoplasm, whereas HCL shows only weak cyclin D1 with abundant hairy cytoplasm.

captions: PB smear: hairy cells with abundant pale cytoplasm and circumferential projections
BM aspirate: sheets of monotonous hairy cells
BM biopsy: fried-egg infiltrate (H&E) with CD20, Annexin A1 and weak BCL1 positivity
Flow cytometry: lambda-restricted CD20-bright B cells expressing CD103, CD25 and CD200, CD123 largely negative
